outline.description: strong continuous deep navy charcoal outer outline (#17243A family), medium-thick at source resolution, with a thinner dark inner separation line where forms overlap
outline.postProcessRule: If generated art has a weak or missing silhouette line, add this outline outside the existing alpha silhouette only. Do not repaint, sharpen, or alter opaque interior pixels.

consistency: reuse the same rendering language, proportions, outline weight, material response, and lighting family across every batch
default player identity is brown hair, blue-gold light gear, cyan destiny crystal or scarf, locked 2.3-head proportion
do not mix flat vector icons with painted chibi assets
keep important shapes centered with generous transparent padding
no text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, or checkerboard background
avoid: soft silhouette without an outer outline
